req.title: Task update rejects id changes
req.statement: The system shall ignore any id field in the PUT body and only mutate the task addressed by the URL.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the task update endpoint should ignore any changes to the task ID in the request body and only update the task identified by the URL. This ensures data integrity by preventing accidental or malicious changes to task identifiers. The test suite includes a positive test to verify correct behavior when no ID change is attempted, a negative test to ensure the system rejects attempts to change the ID, and a boundary test to check behavior with minimal valid input.

tests.name: test_update_task_ignore_id_change
preconditions: A task with ID 1 exists in the database.
actions: Send a PUT request to /tasks/1 with a body containing a different ID.
expected: The task with ID 1 is updated.
The response body contains the updated task with ID 1.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

# Precondition: Create a task to update
create_response = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "Initial Task", "description": "Initial Description", "completed": False})
assert create_response.status_code == 201
created_task = create_response.json()

# Action: Attempt to update the task with a different ID in the body
update_response = client.put(f"/tasks/{created_task['id']}", json={"id": created_task['id'] + 1, "title": "Updated Task", "description": "Updated Description", "completed": True})

# Expected: The task with the original ID is updated
assert update_response.status_code == 200
updated_task = update_response.json()
assert updated_task['id'] == created_task['id']
assert updated_task['title'] == "Updated Task"
assert updated_task['description'] == "Updated Description"
assert updated_task['completed'] is True

tests.name: test_update_task_with_invalid_id
preconditions: A task with ID 1 exists in the database.
actions: Send a PUT request to /tasks/999 with a body containing a valid task update.
expected: The response body contains an error message indicating the task was not found.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

# Precondition: Create a task to update
create_response = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "Initial Task", "description": "Initial Description", "completed": False})
assert create_response.status_code == 201

# Action: Attempt to update a non-existent task
update_response = client.put("/tasks/999", json={"title": "Updated Task", "description": "Updated Description", "completed": True})

# Expected: The task is not found
assert update_response.status_code == 404
assert "Task with id 999 not found" in update_response.json()['detail']

preconditions: A task with ID 1 exists in the database.
actions: Send a PUT request to /tasks/1 with a minimal valid update body.
expected: The task with ID 1 is updated with the minimal changes.

from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

# Precondition: Create a task to update
create_response = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "Initial Task", "description": "Initial Description", "completed": False})
assert create_response.status_code == 201
created_task = create_response.json()

# Action: Update the task with minimal valid data

# Expected: The task is updated with minimal changes
assert update_response.status_code == 200
updated_task = update_response.json()
assert updated_task['id'] == created_task['id']
assert updated_task['title'] == "Updated Task"
assert updated_task['description'] == "Initial Description"
assert updated_task['completed'] is False
